{{Quote|Quarra, right? You really ought to think about that hat. It pays to keep your hair short here, too. The arachnorids are hideous here.|Orielle Kitai|<ref name="Lost Tribe of the Sith: Pandemonium">''[[Lost Tribe of the Sith: Pandemonium]]''</ref>}}
'''Arachnorids''' were an arachnid species that were found on the planet [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]]. They lived in the jungle highlands of the continent of [[Keshtah Minor]]. While building their new [[Orielle Kitai and Jelph Marrian's home|home]] in the jungle highlands of Keshtah, the former [[Lost Tribe of Sith|Sith]] [[Orielle Kitai]] and her [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] husband [[Jelph Marrian]] encountered several arachnorids. Orielle Kitai regarded them as a pest and as a result cut her hair short. During a [[Force vision/Legends|Force vision]] with the [[Keshiri/Legends|Keshiri]] woman [[Quarra Thayn]] in [[2975 BBY]], Orielle briefly mentioned the presence of arachnorids before encouraging and giving advice to Quarra, who was separated by a wide gulf of time and distance.
